title: Small group with Robichaux on Decatur Street
summary: A short stint with Mineta, Red Dugas and Freddie Babu in a seamen's place near Toulouse.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: One little group that I played with, I can't remember whether it was before I started playing with Paul Mollier, whether it was shortly afterwards, before I had gone to St. Louis, but there was Mr. Mineta, a fellow named Red Dugas playing drums. Oh yeah. A trombone player, his name was Freddie Babu.
Yeah, maybe heard the name, but I don't know anything about him. Freddie Babu. Yeah. I played some bandages, somebody might have mentioned that.
And Joe Robichaux and I, I was playing banjo then. And we played at a little place down on Charter Street. It was only for a short while. We played there on...
Well, where on Charter? There's nothing here.
Either Charter or Decatur, but it was down there about Toulouse, somewhere in that area down there. It was frequented by seamen.
Yeah, probably maybe Decatur then. Most likely. Several people told us they played there.
